verdict.rationale: Pulley's docs say founders can draft SAFEs from standard YC templates and collect board and investor signatures in-platform without a third-party e-signature tool. SAFEs appear on a dedicated cap table tab, and the fundraising modeler produces pro-formas for an upcoming SAFE or priced round. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that executed SAFEs automatically post to the cap table, documentation of how conversion terms (cap, discount, MFN) are captured and modeled, in-platform creation and signing of convertible notes (only a cap table tab is evidenced), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
